abuseDefense.title: Abuse defense
abuseDefense.description: The magic-link pages load Cloudflare's Turnstile challenge script and frame, which let Cloudflare process browser and network signals to distinguish people from bots. The application sends the resulting opaque token to Cloudflare Siteverify, but does not add the optional visitor IP field, enable widget failure feedback, retain the token or provider response in application data or ordinary logs, or surface provider error codes. Describe the deployment's actual retention and link to Cloudflare's {addendum}.
